entries.en: The chair beside Professor Wei was left empty for the visiting speaker.
entries.zh: 魏教授旁边的椅子空着，留给来访的演讲者。

entries.en: For her entrance as Nox, the Roman goddess of night, Maya wore a cloak scattered with silver stars.
entries.zh: 玛雅扮演罗马司夜女神诺克斯出场时，披着一件缀有银色星星的斗篷。

entries.meaningZh: 韦 (旧时英国重量或容量单位)
entries.en: The old English account book lists a wey of wool among the goods delivered to the abbey.
entries.zh: 那本旧时英国账簿在送往修道院的货物中列有一韦羊毛。

entries.meaningZh: 嘎斯（俄罗斯汽车品牌名称）
entries.en: The old GAZ van rattled as it climbed the steep road to the farm.
entries.zh: 那辆老旧的嘎斯厢式货车沿着通往农场的陡路爬行时，哐当作响。

entries.en: A wooden model of an AAM hung above the aircraft display.
entries.zh: 飞机展品上方悬着一个木制空对空导弹模型。

entries.en: "Adsum!" Thomas called from the back row when the headmaster read out his name.
entries.zh: 校长点到托马斯的名字时，他从后排高声答道：“到！”

entries.en: In the old play, the king cries, "Alack, my son will not return!"
entries.zh: 在那部古老的戏剧中，国王悲呼：“呜呼，我的儿子不会回来了！”

entries.en: "Alackaday, the frost has taken every blossom," the gardener laments in the old tale.
entries.zh: “哀哉，霜冻毁了每一朵花！”老故事中的园丁这样悲叹道。

entries.en: "I'll walk home, altho it may take a while," she texted.
entries.zh: 她发短信说：“我会走回家，虽然可能要花些时间。”

entries.en: The technician circled the damaged AMB in the photograph of the memory module.
entries.zh: 技术员在那张内存模块照片上圈出了损坏的高级内存缓冲器。

entries.en: Army Capt. Nolan checked the names before the training exercise began.
entries.zh: 陆军上尉诺兰在训练演习开始前核对了名单。

entries.en: The workshop will run from 8 to 12 Feb.
entries.zh: 研讨会将于2月8日至12日举行。

entries.en: I bet the spare batteries are in the top drawer of the kitchen cabinet.
entries.zh: 我敢说，备用电池就在厨房柜子最上面的抽屉里。

entries.en: I dare say the café will be quieter after the lunchtime crowd leaves.
entries.zh: 我想，午餐时段的客人离开后，咖啡馆会安静些。

entries.en: I guess we'll have to carry the boxes upstairs one at a time.
entries.zh: 我想，我们得把这些箱子一个一个搬上楼。

entries.en: Leave it by the door—I mean the side door, not the front one.
entries.zh: 把它放在门边——我是说侧门，不是前门。

entries.en: "The shop is closed today." "I thought as much; the windows were dark when I passed."
entries.zh: “商店今天不营业。”“我也料到了；我路过时，窗户里黑乎乎的。”

entries.en: The diary entry for 3 Jan. describes the family's arrival in their new home.
entries.zh: 1月3日那篇日记记录了那家人抵达新家的情景。

entries.en: The loan of the painting ends on 20 Jul., so it must be packed before then.
entries.zh: 这幅画的借展期7月20日结束，因此必须在那之前把它包装好。

entries.en: The museum's handwritten receipt is dated 6 Jun., but the parcel did not arrive until the following week.
entries.zh: 博物馆那张手写收据的日期是6月6日，但包裹直到下一周才送到。

entries.en: The rehearsal listed for 14 Mar. has been moved to the following Friday.
entries.zh: 原定3月14日的排练已经改到了随后那个星期五。

entries.en: The faded postmark still shows 9 Nov., although the year is unreadable.
entries.zh: 褪色的邮戳仍看得出11月9日，不过年份已无法辨认。

entries.en: The final costume fitting is pencilled in for 18 Oct., but the room is not yet confirmed.
entries.zh: 最后一次试装暂定在10月18日，不过房间还没确定。

entries.en: She wiped the dust from the VDT before reconnecting it to the computer.
entries.zh: 她先擦去视频显示终端上的灰尘，再把它重新连接到计算机。
